scope: read archived trades/opportunities/accounts; no strategy replay, exit optimization, AI fit or new signals

normalizations.R0: abs(raw_entry-original_stop), gross price risk; never changed
normalizations.R_model: archived planned_risk/quantity, verified against original fee/slippage unit risk
normalizations.ATR_pre: prebreak exact original14TR/14, no new stop

bounds: entry limit bar and intrabar exit bar extremes are only loose envelopes; guaranteed lower includes known entry/exit quotes and fully held observations; missing/zero-volume bars remove true upper bound; never invent intrabar order
censoring: fixed tape cannot cross next2023/2025/frozen-end boundary; held prefix ending earlier at original exit is not a full-horizon survivor; source original exits never changed
arrival_clock: first quote at open may be exact, otherwise hourly interval; uncertain entry/exit bar gives possible-only unless known quote confirms; same-bar TP/SL or MFE/MAE order unknown; gaps unknown
giveback: MFE gross minus endpoint gross, not MFE minus netR; realized cost drag separately; favorable quote net potential is posthoc upper accounting only, never realized PnL
directionless_proxy: hourly-close efficiency abs(endpoint-entry)/sum(abs(consecutive known closes)); fraction of observed closes within+/-0.5R0; no intrabar dwell-time claims
features: separate closed first20D-breach candle at registration from entry context; prebreak ATR/ER/compression strictly before breach, body/wicks/RVOL available only after breach closes; no entry-bar final OHLCV, future pivot, exit, PnL, MFE or MAE as features
compression: prebreak ATR14 / mean(strictly previous20 ATR14), current excluded; exact Decimal TR sums; <1 compressed, >=1 not_compressed; contiguous history required
break_geometry: abs(C-O)/(H-L), upper/lower wick/range, signed close/extreme beyond frozen20D level over prebreakATR, close location in frozen20D range; zero range undefined; previous UTC breach day reference retained even when registration is midnight
existing_context: reuse P1-08A registration/entry MA1H/4H/1D, ER, ATR, RVOL and known normal-stop cost share; non20D-family break geometry unavailable, not fabricated
deferred: entry-hour final geometry/RVOL require next close; future pivot requires right confirmations; catalog only, not feature values
associations: all fixed bins and continuous correlations output; actual accounts and all eligible isolated opportunities separate; source final rejection is label metadata, never feature

hypotheses.prediction: higher24h tape MFE in R0 and ATR_pre without higher24h MAE_R0
higher24h tape MFE in R0 and ATR_pre without higher24h MAE_R0

hypothesis_stage_gate: hypothesis formation only, not strategy validation: Train and Validation each arm>=30, delta_MFE_R0>0 and delta_MFE_ATRpre>0 and delta_MAE_R0<=0 in both, pooled95 block deltaMFE lower>0; BTC/other7/openedTest each arm>=10 and no MFE sign reversal, otherwise insufficient/not recommended; never infer executable profit from postexit tape
falsification: fresh frozen replication fails predicted MFE sign or raises adverse movement; same rules/normalizations and complete population retained; no threshold retuning, no positive-expectancy claim
uncertainty: reuse shared28-day calendar block bootstrap1000 seed808, global across coins; do not pool scenarios, periods or duplicate account/event labels
